t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 6 different colored gnomes.  There are 2 colors of gnomes that give more mushrooms when the gnomes are placed on the left side.  I am not sure though which color was stated I think it was pink and purple.  Also, there is a specific colored basket that will also add to the amount of mushrooms that you would collect whether it be in a higher + number or not.  There are different colored wooded backgrounds that also make a difference in the amount of mushrooms that you can collect.  There is definitely a correlation between gnome colors and the side that the gnomes are placed on. You can only try your best and try to figure out the specifics.  Good luck!

vb_textbox.text: There are 6 different colored gnomes.  Purple and Pink gave the most mushrooms when on the right side of the screen and yellow and green on the left side of the screen.  The number of mushrooms also depends on the colored basket that correlates to the gnome you chose. Remember to press the space bar when the basket appears, sometimes I would space off and forget.
